planets.name: TOI-237 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-237 with a 1.74-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-237 c was found in 2026 by La Silla Observatory as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-237. Its orbit and size follow Timmermans et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
